Ketu.title: Subtle Fatigue & Hard-to-Pinpoint Sensitivity
Ketu.desc: Sensitive nervous perception picks up ambient stress before routine labs show changes. Preventive checkups and unhurried rest keep vitality crystal clear.

Ketu.title: Irregular Appetite & Skipped Meals
Ketu.desc: Deep mental absorption makes it easy to forget lunch until lightheadedness hits. Simple nourishing reminders keep blood sugar and mood rock steady.

Ketu.title: Foot Arch Tension & Cold Extremities
Ketu.desc: Cool floors and long standing without support tire plantar arches and ankles. Warm evening foot soaks and supportive footwear restore grounded comfort.

Ketu.title: Quiet Dehydration During Deep Focus
Ketu.desc: Losing track of time in study or meditation reduces subtle thirst cues. Keeping a copper or glass bottle beside your desk maintains steady alertness.

Sun.title: The Leader
Sun.desc: Past-life training in governance and responsibility returns as an unmistakable call to stand up for collective integrity. Your soul grows whenever leadership serves others rather than personal ego.

Sun.title: The Sovereign Illuminator
Sun.desc: You incarnated to bring transparent light into confused rooms and model quiet self-respect. Standing unapologetically in honest values awakens courage in everyone around you.

Sun.title: The Noble Patron
Sun.desc: Protecting talent, elders, and civic standards mirrors ancient royal dharma. Sharing credit freely makes your authority magnetic and deeply blessed.

Moon.title: The Sanctuary Maker
Moon.desc: Deep ancestral memory of tending families and communities equips you with rare emotional radar. Your mission is turning anxious spaces into safe harbors of belonging.

Moon.title: The Compassionate Mirror
Moon.desc: Through tender listening and intuitive art, you remind busy souls how to feel whole again. Caring for your own inner peace first ensures your reservoir never runs dry.

Moon.title: The Lineage Weaver
Moon.desc: Healing generational patterns with forgiveness rather than resentment liberates both past and future. Warm hospitality becomes sacred spiritual practice in your hands.

Mars.title: The Fearless Protector
Mars.desc: Past-life mastery of discipline and boundary defense makes you someone people count on in crisis. Your dharma blooms when courage defends the vulnerable calmly.

Mars.title: The Trailblazer
Mars.desc: You came to break stale inertia and build bold foundations where others hesitated. Channeling restless drive into patient craft turns fire into lasting light.

Mars.title: The Disciplined Warrior-Yogi
Mars.desc: Transforming reactive anger into steady sacred willpower is your crowning spiritual victory. Daily physical movement keeps your heroic energy clean and uplifting.

Mercury.title: The Truth Translator
Mercury.desc: Across lifetimes as a scholar, scribe, or messenger, you refined the art of making complex wisdom clear. Your mission is bridging divided minds through honest, lucid dialogue.

Mercury.title: The Eternal Student
Mercury.desc: Playful curiosity keeps your spirit agile long after peers settle into dogma. Asking the clean, essential question unlocks breakthroughs for whole communities.

Mercury.title: The Bridge Builder
Mercury.desc: Uniting thinkers, artisans, and practical builders accelerates collective dharma effortlessly. Kindness in everyday speech transforms information into genuine wisdom.

Jupiter.title: The Teacher
Jupiter.desc: Carrying centuries of philosophical and ethical study in your soul memory, teaching feels like breathing. Guiding seekers with humility—never superiority—fulfills your highest dharma.

Jupiter.title: The Dharma Keeper
Jupiter.desc: You naturally weigh choices against long-term truth, fairness, and generational grace. Presence over preaching allows your lived example to uplift thousands.

Jupiter.title: The Joyful Benefactor
Jupiter.desc: Opening doors for deserving students, artists, and institutions multiplies auspicious grace in your own life. Gratitude turns ordinary days into quiet pilgrimage.

Venus.title: The Sacred Harmonist
Venus.desc: Your soul remembers how beauty, music, and gracious hospitality soften hardened hearts. Elevating everyday life with mindful art awakens Bhakti in modern spaces.

Venus.title: The Heart Diplomat
Venus.desc: Reconciling opposites through empathy, fairness, and aesthetic warmth marks your spiritual signature. True love becomes your clearest mirror of cosmic unity.

Venus.title: The Devotional Creator
Venus.desc: Creating spaces, melodies, or objects infused with care reminds people that life is meant to be savored respectfully. Choosing depth over fleeting glamour fulfills your joy.

Saturn.title: The Ethical Steward
Saturn.desc: Unfinished vows of quiet, selfless service give you rare endurance when others tire early. Doing ordinary duties with extraordinary integrity unlocks deep liberation.

Saturn.title: The Patient Builder
Saturn.desc: Your soul honors slow maturation over flashy shortcuts, building institutions that shelter future generations. Accepting time as an ally dissolves needless anxiety.

Saturn.title: The Quiet Equalizer
Saturn.desc: Standing faithfully beside hardworking, overlooked people reflects Shani's deepest compassion. Humility transforms heavy responsibility into serene freedom.

Rahu.title: The Boundary Explorer
Rahu.desc: Your soul intentionally chose unfamiliar cultures, modern tech, or unconventional paths to grow beyond old comfort zones. Courageous curiosity paired with ethical anchors unlocks destiny.

Rahu.title: The Modernizer
Rahu.desc: Translating timeless human needs into breakthrough contemporary systems fulfills your forward vector. Sharing abundance transparently keeps ambition deeply wholesome.

Rahu.title: The Pattern Breaker
Rahu.desc: Questioning inherited limitations lets your family lineage step into wider horizons. Grounding breakthroughs in daily stillness prevents restless burnout.

Ketu.title: The Healer
Ketu.desc: Past-life devotion to contemplative medicine and inner awareness gives you uncanny intuitive insight into root causes. Offering help without attachment multiplies both peace and healing.

Ketu.title: The Truth Seeker
Ketu.desc: Surface applause rarely satisfies your spirit because you already tasted quiet inner truth in past lives. Meditation, nature, and honest service keep your compass radiant.

Ketu.title: The Detached Sage
Ketu.desc: Walking lightly through praise and blame makes you an anchor of calm clarity for loved ones. Bringing spiritual insight gently into practical daily kindness completes your circle.
